THE THINGS WORTH SAYING

Good advice isn’t always a sale.

01 / You might need fewer licences.

Review actual usage and requirements before renewing. A smaller licence bill can be the right result.

02 / Some of your hardware is fine.

A refresh cycle should follow risk, performance and supportability — not a reseller’s calendar.

03 / If your provider is good, stay.

A responsive relationship that works is worth keeping. Understand the problem before planning a move.
